content.short: Hidden away in the depths of storied lands lives a collection of 10,000 unique baby dragons.
content.description:
Hello, world! We’ve been working super hard on this project, and we’re finally ready to let you in on the details. Here’s a roadmap to Baby Dragon Realm development goals.

NFT Designs Generating 9995 unique NFTs with 5 types of elemental attributes and 5 exclusive 1/1s with special attribute traits.

Secondary Market Verifying and releasing Baby Dragon NFTs on CNFT, so users can easily identify our NFTs to buy & sell them on their marketplace.

Game Development Building P2E Auto Battler game around our NFTs where players fight against AI using their dragons.

Deployment of the game in the testnet Testing the game with varying power levels for the dragons and achieving game balance.

Token Launch Creating a smart contract for our in-game token. This will be integrated with the game economy and will be used in the game.

Marketplace and Blacksmith Introducing marketplace for buying and selling baby dragons and dragon eggs. Players can buy Dragon eggs and try to hatch them. Players will also be able to craft weapons for dragon battles and sell them to other players.

Deployment of the full game ecosystem on Testnet Full game testing by fusing both the game and the ecosystem along with token rewards.

Deployment of the full game in Mainnet Moving the game to the Mainnet with all functionalities and rewarding players for wins.

Hunting and Lands Players can go hunting to find dragon eggs or other in-game items by spending game tokens. The gaming realm allows entry into different lands, each having its own terrain sheltering dragons of that geography. Players can own lands that payout tokens when other players hunt in their land.

Deployment of PvP game mode in Testnet Deploying Player vs Player game mode, along with leaderboard in testnet and making necessary balance changes to the power levels of dragons and their abilities.

Deployment of PvP game mode in Mainnet Officially introducing Player vs Player game mode in the mainnet.

Now, from here to there seems like a long way but this team is riding at full throttle. After all, even the sky is no limit for dragons, right? Follow our journey to stay up to date with our progress.
